title: Project/BIM Browser and Property Inspector Integration
objective: Make browser, canvas and typed property inspection behave as one professional modeling workspace.
requirements: stable engineering object identifiers are mandatory
browser and canvas selections share WorkspaceManager state
selection resolves to real objects before reaching the property palette
missing objects remain visible in synchronization evidence without fabricating properties
standard project browser and inspector panels are registered idempotently
typed property editing and undo remain delegated to the existing validated controller
boundary: This increment integrates headless professional interaction contracts; rendered Qt composition is a later acceptance gate.
